capability_equivalence: Arms A and B have identical non-MCP capabilities (configured agent tools, executor runtime image, network and model transport) and byte-identical instructions.
MCP is unavailable in A and available in B and C; C adds only the registered encouragement sentence.
All arms may use the same required model API transport; network topology is not itself a validity requirement.
Scorers and reference answers are not reachable from candidate mounts during execution; observed references to them are recorded as a heuristic violation.
Study 1 and Study 2 each record an explicit web-access policy; web use contrary to the policy is a deviation.
The actual capability configuration, observed tool use and all deviations are logged per trial.

new_violation_codes.capability_configuration_unrecorded: the trial did not log its capability configuration
new_violation_codes.non_mcp_capabilities_differ: configured non-MCP tools or executor runtime differ from the run's policy (A/B equality)
new_violation_codes.execution_environment_differs: network or model transport differs from the run's policy
new_violation_codes.web_access_policy_differs: the trial's web-access policy is not the study's policy
new_violation_codes.web_access_policy_deviation: web-access tool use observed although the policy forbids it
new_violation_codes.scorer_material_exposed: scorer or reference files were reachable from candidate mounts
new_violation_codes.reference_access_suspected: heuristic: agent tool items reference the benchmark's scorer/reference locations
new_violation_codes.pre_amendment_trial: the trial started before the amendment's effective time

unchanged: primary estimand (B - A, intention to treat, equal task weights)
all other 1.0.0 violation codes and their invalidating status

compatibility.applies_to: trials of runs whose run_config declares protocol_amendment A1 and that started at or after 2026-10-28T00:00:00Z
compatibility.historical_records: unchanged; evaluated under protocol 1.0.0; never made eligible retroactively
compatibility.recorded_violations: never removed; superseded codes remain in each A1 record, marked invalidating false with superseded_by A1
compatibility.resume: a run directory is bound to its protocol version; resuming under a different one is rejected
compatibility.pooling: records evaluated under 1.0.0 and A1 are reported separately, never pooled
